author: voidloop
body:
Hello,
I've comed up with this idea.

Pretty much, I wanna do a project In which I and some Staff for this project find as many different people as possible to say:
“Avicus is a global server “ in as many languages as possible.

Obviously I need Help with this!
So please, If you know how to say the sentence written at the top in one of the following languages, write it down below with this short formage.
[Language]: What language you want to translate it to!
[Level]: What's your level in that Language!
[Skype Name]: Self explanatory

[Languages]

Spanish- Javipepe
English: JustPlainOscar/OscarElNana
German: Free position.
French: Free position.
Italian: Free position.
Hebrew: Free Position
Swedish: Robin_DD_J
Portuguese: Free position
Philippine: Free position
Balkans:   Free position
Russian: Free position
Dutch: Thrasillias
-----------------------------------------------------[Staff for the Project]-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
I need people that can Help me, There's no appliance, simply say: I want to help with this or something similar and you'll probably get chosen.

Thanks for your Time,
Ethan
